patterns.name: Lavender Bloom Spray
patterns.construction: A wired stem is wrapped in crochet, then topped with a tapered cluster of small looped lavender florets worked directly around the upper stem.
patterns.summary: A slender lavender-inspired flower spray with a softly tapered purple bloom, designed as the main vertical feature of a wall hoop.

patterns.name: Five-Petal Wildflower
patterns.construction: A small circular centre is worked first, with five rounded petals made around its edge; it can be sewn onto a stem or directly to the hoop arrangement.
patterns.summary: A simple five-petal blossom with a neat centre, suited to soft blush or cream accents in a botanical hoop.

patterns.name: Meadow Bud Cluster
patterns.construction: Tiny rounded buds are crocheted separately, secured to short wired branch stems, and gathered into one light, airy filler spray.
patterns.summary: An airy branching spray of tiny cream or oat buds that fills open spaces between larger floral elements.

patterns.name: Sage Leaf Sprig
patterns.construction: A wrapped central stem carries pairs of flat pointed leaves crocheted individually and sewn or wrapped in a gentle staggered line.
patterns.summary: A muted-sage leafy sprig with paired pointed leaves, providing soft foliage behind lavender blooms and wildflowers.

patterns.name: Crochet Hoop Band
patterns.construction: A narrow textured crochet band is worked to the circumference of an embroidery hoop, then laced or sewn around the outer ring to create a finished botanical base.
patterns.summary: A slim warm-ivory crochet cover for a 20 cm embroidery hoop, creating a polished base for the floral wall display.

combinations.title: Wall Hoop Arrangement Ideas
combinations.intro: Use the covered hoop as a calm botanical frame, arranging sprays asymmetrically with the lavender bloom as the visual centre.

items.name: Lavender Meadow Hoop
notes: Position the lavender sprays slightly off-centre and layer sage sprigs behind them.
Use wildflowers and bud clusters to soften the outer edges of the arrangement.

items.name: Quiet Botanical Posy
notes: Tie or sew the stems into a small posy for a gift topper, shelf accent or hoop centrepiece.
